result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.count_nodes()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Count the total number of nodes in the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L3692-L3738){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns the current number of nodes (vertices) in the graph. This count includes all nodes that have been added and not deleted. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The total number of nodes in the graph. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Count nodes in a simple graph: ::: {#785309f7 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") ) # Returns 3 graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 3 ``` ::: ::: Track nodes after deletion: ::: {#7da021e4 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .delete_node("B") ) # Returns 2 graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
